places-former-hacienda-of-cieneguilla-ca.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-former-hacienda-of-cieneguilla-ca.story: From Centro de Arriba it runs 271 km to Centro de Arriba; allow about 4 h 40 of riding. The stops in between: Former hacienda of Pabellón de Hidalgo, Camino Real de Tierra Adentro and back through Former hacienda of Pabellón de Hidalgo. The highest point is about 2,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
